# OpenRocket compatibility fixture

`dual-deployment.ork` is an unchanged copy of OpenRocket's
`core/src/main/resources/datafiles/examples/Dual parachute deployment.ork`.

Source: https://github.com/openrocket/openrocket/blob/591c5e5f7b7377e48f2bd5e501cef25cdfbd61d8/core/src/main/resources/datafiles/examples/Dual%20parachute%20deployment.ork

Upstream commit: `591c5e5f7b7377e48f2bd5e501cef25cdfbd61d8`.
Design author recorded by the document: Joe Pfeiffer, adapted from Hichory Dichory Mach.

This test fixture is distributed under OpenRocket's GNU GPL v3 or later;
see the full accompanying `LICENSE.TXT`. This notice applies to this fixture,
not the MIT-licensed application source. It is included only for offline
compatibility tests and is not packaged into the desktop application.
